command:
set -eu
echo FW_ROUTE_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo FW_TCON_TREE
if test -d /prd/lib/firmware/tcon; then
 find /prd/lib/firmware/tcon -maxdepth 8 -print | awk 'NR<=80 {print substr($0,1,256)} length($0)>256 {long++} END {print "TREE_ROWS",NR; print "LONG_PATHS",long+0}'
fi
echo FW_PLACEHOLDER_METADATA
for p in /prd/lib/firmware/tcon/default_tcon/tcon_flash_data/dummy.bin /prd/lib/firmware/tcon/default_tcon/tcon_flash_fw/dummy.bin; do
 if test -f "$p" && test ! -L "$p"; then
  stat -c '%n %s %u:%g:%a' "$p"
  sha256sum "$p"
 fi
done
echo FW_ROUTE_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
